propositions: rebar must support s3:// URLs as sync.remote values with SSE-KMS encryption, enabling init/mount/create/claim/transition/push/fetch workflows against an S3 bucket instead of GitHub

concurrent or legacy pushes to S3 can create multiple <sha>.bundle files for a single ref, causing git ls-remote to return divergent SHAs and hard-failing fresh clones with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed'

rebar must fail closed with an actionable error message when sync.remote is s3:// but git-remote-s3 is missing or below the minimum pinned version, rather than silently risking multi-bundle corruption

rebar must auto-heal multi-bundle corruption non-interactively by merging all divergent heads into a single bundle, ensuring git ls-remote returns exactly one SHA per ref, fresh clones succeed, and no commits or events are discarded

an operator must be able to configure S3 as the ticket-store backend from documentation alone, including optional dependency installation, minimum helper version, SSE-KMS bucket and IAM setup, and sync.remote configuration
